name: Flat pizza slice
summary: Flat pizza slice with crust, pepperoni and a melted cheese drip. For takeaway, snack or Italian food scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the slice tip rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~320 px wide); use about 0.2 to 0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = rock on its tip, pop = scale in

author: krakujs
